name: mtdt
description: mtdt.io MCP: Salesforce DevOps platform connector (metadata deployments, backups and more)

interface.longDescription:
Use mtdt.io to work with the Salesforce orgs connected to your team. Find source and target orgs, inspect deployment history, and prepare deployments from an org, a Git repository, or a usable metadata backup. Browse metadata, save the component selection, and preview execution settings before launch. Run pre-deployment checks for dependencies, target conflicts, permissions, and backup recommendations. Validate a selected package with Apex tests, follow its status, and quick-deploy a successful validation. You can also start metadata backups and inspect their progress.

The package includes deployment and troubleshooting skills. It connects to the hosted mtdt.io MCP server using browser-based OAuth sign-in. You need an mtdt.io account and connected Salesforce orgs. Viewing requires the mtdt:read scope; tools that create deployments, retrieve metadata, validate, or run backups require mtdt:deploy. Your team roles and target approval policies still apply. Validation checks the package without deploying its metadata to the target; quick-deploy and direct deployment can overwrite target metadata. Preflight findings are advisory. Review the run preview before launch: saved actions such as Apex scripts and scheduled-job pauses can have effects even during validation.
defaultPrompt: Show my connected Salesforce orgs and recent deployments.
Check a Salesforce metadata deployment before validation.
Help me understand why my last deployment failed.

publication.release_notes: Adds existing-deployment link/unlink for Work Items through user-scoped product RPC, preserving group restrictions and audit. Explains Work Items, reusable deployment drafts and individual runs in the supplied skill. Refreshes the 42-tool local inventory and reviewer examples; verify hosted rollout separately.
